We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product. Multiplying the first row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}3 & 4 \\ 2 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}3\cdot 2+4\cdot 2 \\ ∗\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}14 \\ ∗\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the second row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}3 & 4 \\ 2 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}14 \\ 2\cdot 2+6\cdot 2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}14 \\ 16\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 4 \\ 2 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}14 \\ 16\end{aligned}].
$$
